description:
One of the second generation Grimms Models created as a successor to the Goddess Squad.
Although her specifications surpass that of the Goddess Squad, she was not deployed in actual battles due to corruption.
After receiving treatment, she has been fighting alone with zero support to overcome the stigma of being humanity's enemy.

lines.text:
Oh? Did you need something?
I'm a bit preoccupied admiring myself in the mirror right now.
I don't believe there are enough mirrors here.
It's so beautiful today. I like it.

Please try and maintain your current appearance, Prince.
If your beauty fades, your audience will abandon you.

Thank you for awakening me.
Because of you, we now have the chance to rewrite our story.

Be sure to watch our new story through to the end.
It is sure to be beautiful.

Leaving me abandoned like this is hardly a beautiful thing to do.
If you have something to say, please do so quickly.

You are beautiful as well,
and beautiful things should always remain in the same place.

This is a beautiful place, I like it.
All we have to do is install a lot of mirrors.
How about outfitting all the buildings with mirrors?
It feels wonderful to walk amongst this place.

Who do you think is the most beautiful person in the world?
No need to answer, for I already know.
I feel as though my beauty has reached new heights.
My Glass Slippers have become so clean, so majestic.
My body feels so much lighter. We should go out at once.
Thank you, but a mirror would have been even better.

You're really great at finding things that suit me.
Of course, everything looks fabulous on me.
It's a beautiful present. Thank you.

You're becoming more beautiful by the day.
Would you like to look in the mirror and see just how ravishing you've become?
Our story, as well as yours, is bound to be beautiful.
I now know what it feels like to be rapturously beautiful.
I will go with you.
Did you call?
It is not becoming to rush. I will go slowly.

They are humanity's enemy,
and so I shall defeat them.
Let us get off to a beautiful start.
Gaze upon me, my audience.
I will clean up neatly and beautifully.
Let me check the mirror for a moment.
There's some dirt on my face.
Even when I'm preparing, I'm gorgeous.
Prince, now is the time.
Glass Slippers, full contact. Unleash.
Now is the time of true beauty.
All sorted.
There are more?
Pathetic.
Ow!
How annoying.
Urgh!
This is not a beautiful story.
What a truly beautiful story this was. I am most pleased with it.
I feel so... beautiful right now.

Amongst this lambent glass, I, too, gleam with brilliance.
I am satisfied.
Prince, would you put the glass slippers on me?
With you by my side, I'm shining brighter than ever.

My Prince,
I will become a presence most dazzling to you.

I shall become even more beautiful.
With my glass slippers on, I will stride forward.

Prince, can you return before midnight?
Don't make me wait too long.

Even after midnight, I will continue to shine,
and it's all because of these glass slippers you gave me.

I want to see how beautiful I am right now.
Where should I go?

Is this your palace?
Where will I stay?
If you would, please escort me to the place that suits me best.
My Prince, I shall greet you in my shining glass slippers.
I have become more beautiful!
For my brilliant self.
You have my thanks, Prince.
As expected, your gift to me is the most gorgeous.
Thank you, Prince. I feel more beautiful than I ever have.
Your gifts always sparkle.

I feel like I've been enchanted by a spell...
I can't stop thinking about you.
I hope to become the most beautiful person in your eyes.
Isn't it strange? You seem to shine even more these days.
If you wish it so, Prince, I shall gladly oblige.
I'm listening.
Let us move forward with grace and poise.
An intruder has arrived.
I won't forgive anyone who disrupts the ball.
I shall wrap this up quickly, before midnight.
There are far too many things that lack beauty.
Just a moment... I'll clean my glass slippers.
Rest assured, beauty remains impervious.
Don't worry, Prince. I'll keep you safe.
Prince, I'm ready.
Shine brightly, for my radiant self.
Let us all strive to be beautiful.
Next.
Begone.
You're in the way.
Ow!
Ugh.
Phew...
No... I can't end the story like this...
How do I look now, Prince? Am I beautiful?
Look at how wavy and pretty these frills are. They really make the outfit.
This is my first time wearing a maid dress. I like that it's comfortable yet beautiful.
I wasn't expecting this outfit to be this beautiful. I really like it.
I'm going to give you special treatment, Master.
Prince... I mean, Master, would you mind helping me tie my ribbon?
I heard you like maid uniforms, Master. Well? How do you like this one?
What is a maid supposed to do when her master is absent?
I'll make some omurice while you're gone. You might be hungry when you come back.
I'd like to visit the Maid Cafe someday, too.
Will you teach me how to make a drink, Master?
I heard there are different types of maid uniforms. Can you take me to see some of them?
Today, I'll be calling you "Master" instead of "Prince." Welcome home, Master.
I didn't even know this recipe existed.
I can make better omurice now.
What do you think? Don't I make a proper maid?
Is receiving gifts also part of being a maid?
Receiving a gift from my master feels quite special.
I've been wanting this, and getting it from you makes me even happier. Thank you.
I like how kind you are.
You're all I can think about these days, Master. I might be in trouble.
How much more do you want me to fall for you?
Do you require my service?
Did you call, Master?
I'm heading over.
Don't worry. This won't take long.
I'll show you how beautifully a maid can perform.
Leave everything to me, Master.
I'll be done before the omurice gets cold.
Just a moment while I fix my skirt.
Do I look beautiful?
I hope this doesn't stain.
Time to offer them my services.
Where are you looking, Master?
I'll give it my all, Master.
Don't get me dirty.
I took care of that one.
Go away.
Agh...!
Hngh.
Ngh.
Sorry, Master. I think I need more practice.
Are you satisfied, Master? I'll do even better next time.
